# SheetJS browser reader

`xlsx.full.min.js` is SheetJS Community Edition 0.18.5, the same version already used by LineSight before the ERP dashboard extension. It is now served locally, including inside the background import worker. Original distribution: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/xlsx/0.18.5/xlsx.full.min.js

The unmodified library is distributed under the accompanying `SHEETJS-LICENSE`. This change does not upgrade the library or assert a security audit of that version. Workbook parsing stays in the browser and does not upload ERP files.
